product_description: Predictive threat intelligence that links indicators to our own assets and named owners
problem: Cannot show who acted on a leaked credential finding or when
alternatives: the identity platform's built-in leaked credential alert
in-house dark web searches by the SOC
weak_points: a digital risk protection platform may stop at a list of findings, with no owner; a generic threat intelligence feed gives indicators with no link to our own assets
desired_outcome: Reduce the time from a leaked credential finding to a named owner
capability: asset and owner mapping with a dated response record
trigger: The bank could not show what it monitored or who acted
measure: Time from a leaked credential finding to a named owner, with a dated record
